# MacroQuant 市场研究日报（2026-03-06）

**Headline**: 宏观中性，建议事件驱动下的结构化交易。

- 宏观总分: 50.88
- 风险等级: 中
- 行情源: live
- 新闻源: live

## 热点要闻
- [Vancouver mayor's bitcoin investment proposal blocked by city, provincial law](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/03/06/vancouver-mayor-s-bitcoin-investment-proposal-blocked-by-city-provincial-law) (CoinDesk)
- [Dubai regulator orders KuCoin entities to stop unlicensed operations](https://cointelegraph.com/news/dubai-vara-kucoin-unlicensed-crypto-activity-warning?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound) (Cointelegraph)
- [Pudgy Penguins accused of infringing Original Penguin trademark](https://cointelegraph.com/news/pei-licensing-files-trademark-infringement-lawsuit-against-pudgy-penguins?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound) (Cointelegraph)
- [Altcoin seasons are over, expect ‘non-traditional’ cycles ahead: Bitwise exec](https://cointelegraph.com/news/altcoin-seasons-are-over-expect-non-traditional-cycles-ahead-bitwise-cio?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound) (Cointelegraph)
- [Bitcoin relief rally faces headwinds as bear market persists: analysts](https://cointelegraph.com/news/bitcoin-relief-rally-faces-headwinds-as-bear-market-persists-analysts?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound) (Cointelegraph)
- [Bitcoin and stocks stabilize after early week slide. The bond market isn’t convinced.](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/03/06/bitcoin-and-stocks-stabilize-after-early-week-slide-the-bond-market-isn-t-convinced) (CoinDesk)
- [Almost nobody is talking about altseason anymore. That may be bullish](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/03/06/almost-nobody-is-talking-about-altseason-anymore-that-may-be-bullish) (CoinDesk)
- [XRP drops 3% after failing to break $1.45 resistance](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/03/06/xrp-drops-3-after-failing-to-break-usd1-45-resistance) (CoinDesk)

## 市场复盘
- 总分处于中低位，技术触发信号需要搭配更严格的仓位与止损规则。
- 本周主驱动来自 信用压力，边际变化 +11.9。
- 主要拖累来自 风险偏好，边际变化 -11.4。
- BTC 24H +0.13%，7D +7.67%，执行上优先看关键位是否放量确认。

## AI 决策摘要
- 提供方: gemini
- 状态: pending_config
- 模型: gemini-2.5-pro
- 结论: 建议防守执行，等待趋势与宏观重新共振后再扩仓。
- 建议动作:
  - 优先观察 BTC 与 ETH 的关键位确认，再决定是否扩张 SOL 风险预算。
  - 事件窗口前将杠杆下调到策略上限的 50%-70%。
  - 若宏观总分连续两周下行，降低趋势策略开仓频率。
